title: Water supply.
officialText: Where a connection to an approved water supply is required by Section 318.5 of the New York City Fire Code for rooftop gardens or landscaping exceeding 250 square feet (23 m2), an approved fixture shall be provided for connection to such water supply in accordance with this code.
